cop_method_description.direct_thermal: Direct thermal calculation using water flow and temperature difference (±5% accuracy)

tuya_dashboard.age_note: Screen refreshes every 5 seconds. Each datapoint keeps its own reception time; a connection does not guarantee recent measurements.
tuya_dashboard.fetch_error: Dashboard could not be refreshed. Displayed values may be outdated.

tuya_dashboard.search: Search name, DPS, unit, value or capability
tuya_dashboard.adaptive_note: Adaptive control is enabled and may adjust the setpoint again.
tuya_dashboard.confirmation_note: A sent command is not a device confirmation. “Matching value received” means a later datapoint matched; Tuya does not prove which command caused it.
tuya_dashboard.log_note: One row per Tuya datapoint, including values not yet received. Statistics are tracked while the app runs, even with this page closed. Intervals use the last 50 changes. JSON timestamps use UTC.
tuya_dashboard.preset_note: No verified formula is available for the Tuya H/L presets. Only the reported selection is shown.
tuya_dashboard.app_curve_note: This graph uses the app’s slope and intercept. It is not the Tuya H/L preset or a prediction of the final controlled setpoint.
tuya_dashboard.port_error: Choose a port from 1 to 65535 different from the other dashboards.
tuya_dashboard.invalid_value: Invalid value. Check the permitted range or choice.
